Title: Verify rent-exempt minimum is reserved for new position account
How to test: Create a new staking position and inspect the lamports balance of the created position PDA on a devnet explorer
Expected Result: Position account holds at least the rent-exempt minimum for its data size, paid by the staker

Title: Verify ATA is created once per (wallet, mint) and reused
How to test: Stake twice from the same wallet and inspect whether a new associated token account is created each time
Expected Result: The MEX ATA is created only on the first interaction and reused on subsequent stakes

Title: Verify rent is refunded when a position account is closed
How to test: Fully unstake a position so its account is closed, then check the wallet's SOL balance change
Expected Result: Rent lamports from the closed position account are returned to the appropriate owner (staker or fee payer, per design) minus network fees

Title: Create multiple concurrent positions and test batch claim compute budget
How to test: Open 8–10+ independent positions from one wallet, then attempt to claim/compound all of them in as few transactions as the UI supports
Expected Result: All claims complete without hitting the compute budget limit, or the UI correctly batches/paginates instructions across multiple transactions when the limit would be exceeded

Title: Verify per-transaction compute budget headroom on claim-all
How to test: Use a devnet explorer to inspect compute units consumed by a "claim all positions" transaction with many positions
Expected Result: Compute units consumed stay under the network's per-transaction limit (or the app explicitly requests a higher compute budget via `ComputeBudgetProgram` and it's still within protocol limits)

Title: Attempt to pass a PDA with incorrect seeds as the position account
How to test: Modify the intercepted transaction to reference a manually derived (wrong-seed) PDA instead of the real position account, then submit
Expected Result: Program's account validation (seeds/bump check) rejects the mismatched PDA

Title: Attempt to pass an account from a different program as the position account
How to test: Substitute the position account field with an account owned by an unrelated program (e.g. the System Program's rent sysvar or another dApp's account)
Expected Result: Program rejects the instruction due to owner/discriminator mismatch on the substituted account

Title: Attempt to substitute the pool config account with an attacker-controlled account
How to test: In an admin-adjacent or stake instruction, replace the expected global pool-config account with a fake account crafted by the attacker
Expected Result: Program validates the pool-config account against its expected address/PDA and rejects the substitution

Title: Verify program derives and validates PDAs server-side, not trusting client-supplied pubkeys
How to test: Review/observe on-chain behavior when supplying a syntactically valid but not-derived-from-seeds pubkey for any PDA account argument
Expected Result: Program independently derives the expected PDA and rejects the instruction if the supplied account doesn't match

Title: Verify lock-end timestamp is computed from on-chain Clock, not client time
How to test: Change the local device clock forward by several days, then check the displayed and enforced lock/unlock state for an active position
Expected Result: Lock/unlock state is unaffected by the device clock change
column4: it matches the on-chain Clock/slot-derived timestamp

Title: Verify check-in day boundary uses on-chain Clock
How to test: Attempt a second check-in right around local midnight while the device clock is skewed relative to UTC
Expected Result: One check-in per day is enforced based on on-chain time, not the skewed local device time

Title: Verify behavior right at a day boundary (UTC midnight) for check-in
How to test: Perform a check-in a few minutes before and a few minutes after a UTC day boundary
Expected Result: Check-ins on either side of the real on-chain day boundary are treated as separate days
column4: no double-count or missed day within the same boundary crossing

Title: Attempt to replay a previously confirmed stake transaction
How to test: Resubmit the exact same fully-signed stake transaction (same signature, same recent blockhash) after it has already been confirmed
Expected Result: Second submission is rejected (duplicate signature / already processed), no double stake is created

Title: Attempt to replay a claim transaction using an expired blockhash
How to test: Take an old signed claim transaction referencing a blockhash that has since expired and resubmit it
Expected Result: Transaction is rejected with a blockhash-not-found/expired error

Title: Verify recent-blockhash expiry invalidates stale transactions
How to test: Build and sign a transaction, wait past the ~60-90 second blockhash validity window, then submit
Expected Result: Submission fails due to expired blockhash rather than executing with stale context

Title: Verify transaction atomicity on a forced mid-instruction failure
How to test: Construct a scenario where a later instruction in a multi-instruction transaction should fail (e.g. insufficient balance for a compound-then-transfer sequence) and submit it
Expected Result: The entire transaction fails and rolls back
column4: no partial state change (e.g. no partial compound without the corresponding transfer) is left on-chain

Title: Verify network fee is still charged on a failed transaction
How to test: Submit a transaction that is expected to fail on-chain validation (e.g. blocked unstake before unlock) and check the fee payer's SOL balance before/after
Expected Result: SOL balance decreases by the base transaction fee even though the transaction's instructions did not succeed

Title: Verify rent is paid correctly when auto-compound-at-unlock needs to open new accounts
How to test: Trigger the unlock/auto-compound flow on a position where an additional account must be created as part of settling rewards
Expected Result: Any new account's rent is covered within the same transaction and correctly attributed to the paying party, with no follow-up "insufficient funds" failure

Title: Verify multisig requires the configured signature threshold for admin actions
How to test: Attempt to execute a Squads admin action (e.g. pause staking, update config) with fewer signatures than the configured threshold
Expected Result: Action does not execute until the threshold number of valid signer approvals is reached

Title: Attempt an admin action with an unauthorized (non-member) signer
How to test: Have a wallet that is not a member of the Squads multisig attempt to approve/execute an admin instruction
Expected Result: Approval/execution is rejected
column4: only designated multisig members can contribute valid signatures

Title: Verify a rejected/cancelled multisig proposal does not execute
How to test: Create a Squads proposal for an admin action, have members reject or cancel it before reaching threshold
Expected Result: Proposal is marked rejected/cancelled and the underlying instruction never executes on-chain

Title: Verify multisig proposal expiration behaves correctly
How to test: Create a proposal and let it sit unexecuted past any configured expiration window
Expected Result: Expired proposal cannot be executed even if threshold is later reached, per Squads' expiration rules

Title: Verify indexer stays consistent with on-chain state after an admin/config change
How to test: Have the multisig execute a config change (e.g. update to a parameter) and then query the indexer/read-only API shortly after
Expected Result: Indexer reflects the updated on-chain state within its expected sync latency, with no stale cached values served indefinitely

Title: Verify ATA/account rent accounting does not leak lamports on repeated stake/unstake cycles
How to test: Perform several full stake-then-unstake cycles on the same wallet and track cumulative SOL spent beyond documented network fees
Expected Result: No unexplained SOL/lamport loss occurs beyond rent (correctly refunded on close) and standard transaction fees
